title: Stand Swap
description: Adds item, that allows to save armour stand and swap positions with it.
body:
A lightweight survival-friendly teleport mechanic built around Armour Stand and a Compass.
StandSwap allows players to bind a special compass to an Armour Stand and instantly swap places with it.
This creates a strategic teleport anchor that players can use to return to hidden bases, escape danger or plan clever traps.
You can craft it by this recipe:
Ender pearl| Ender eye|Ender pearl
Purple bed| Compass| Anchor of respawn
Ender pearl| Ender eye|Ender pearl

Features
- Bind the Compass to an Armour Stand
- Instantly swap positions with the saved stand
- Compass automatically points to the stand location
- Built-in cooldown system to prevent abuse
- Automatic chunk loading so the stand can always be found
- Protection against teleporting between dimensions
- Protection against teleporting into water or lava
- Multiplayer safe - each stand can belong to only one player
- Works smoothly on Spigot and PaperMC

How it works
1. Craft the special compass
2. Right-click on Armour Stand to bind it
3. The compass now point to that stand
4. Right-click with the compass to swap places with it

How to install

  1.Install a jar file
  2.Move it into plugin folder in your server
  3.Restart server
  4.Have fun
